name: Foliant
tagline: Turn any PDF into a book you can actually study from.
summary: Foliant is an offline-first reader that turns a PDF into an interactive book. Read it in chapters, highlight in colour, switch to focus mode, and turn what you read into flashcards.
status: Open source, for web (PWA) and Android

features.name: Chapter bookmarks
features.text: Jump between chapters and pick up exactly where you stopped.

features.name: Colour highlights
features.text: Mark what matters in the colours you choose and find it again later.

features.name: Focus reading mode
features.text: Remove everything except the page so long reads stay comfortable.

features.name: Flashcard generation
features.text: Turn passages into question and answer cards that reveal on tap.

features.name: Works offline
features.text: Your library lives on your device, so reading never depends on a connection.

features.name: Installable
features.text: Add it to your home screen as a Progressive Web App, or use the Android app.

privacy.storage: on your device, in the browser's IndexedDB storage
